title: GenderSystem
description: Reference schema for docs/timeline/SPEC.md §7.7's GenderSystem entity (implements P15: gender systems are historical institutions that change over time, not a timeless background condition — 'patriarchy' is not a boolean). Per culture×period, carries six independently dated, independently evidenced, independently confidence-rated dimensions. No field anywhere aggregates them into a patriarchy: yes/no value — the validator explicitly rejects a top-level or dimensions-level 'patriarchy' key. The hand-rolled validator (docs/timeline/scripts/validate-timeline.mjs) is authoritative if this file and the validator diverge.

culture_id.description: Id of the Culture entity this GenderSystem describes, for this period.

period.description: A society's arrangements in one period say nothing automatic about the next (P15) — every GenderSystem is scoped to a specific period, never presented as a culture's timeless condition.

dimensions.description: All six keys are required (SPEC.md §7.7). Where evidence is absent, use assessment 'UNKNOWN' with confidence UNKNOWN and empty evidence[] rather than omitting the key — 'no data' is itself recorded, not silently dropped.

assessment.description: Plain-prose answer to this dimension's question, e.g. 'Property-owning rights documented for elite women in period X; unclear for non-elite women.'

change_events.description: Notes on documented shifts within this dimension across the period, if any.
